newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BARGE RATES - MOSTLY STEADY IN NEARBYS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BARGE RATES - MOSTLY STEADY IN NEARBYS.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly light, steady levels on Friday for the nearby positions on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, Upper Mississippi River, this week, bid 155 percent of tariff, unchanged from August 6, no offer.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, Upper Mississippi River, next week, bid 155 percent, no comparison, no offer.
